payload.title: Review RSS and headless guides against their shared foundation
payload.description:
Design-only planning requested by Ryan during voice. Implementation remains unstarted; no code, infrastructure, deployment, purchase or publishing authorization is implied. Initial status stays open (Discovery), unassigned.

Cross-cutting acceptance review: verify workflow-owned RSS and headless documentation against the versioned implemented contracts and common published-content visibility foundation. Check discoverability, stable IDs/canonical URLs, updates/withdrawals/freshness, Markus body fields, lists/filter/pagination/assets, errors, public field allowlists and no-draft examples. Verify sample links/requests and permission boundaries using appropriate later tests. Preserve explicit deferred/YAGNI scope and avoid claiming M8 latest/search JSON already provides the new full contracts. Record evidence and remaining gaps.
